title: the event store, the attributed usage query and the ClickHouse log store

reasons.associations: ActiveRecord associations: the logs keep the IDs of their organization, user, API key and resource, read by libs/auth (user emails) and the API.
reasons.log-id: ActiveRecord callback generating a missing ID: Tanvo's log writers always set the ID (a UUIDv7 for security and activity logs, the request ID for API logs) before the log is stored.
reasons.available: Tanvo serves the logs in every installation, from PostgreSQL without ClickHouse (parity §1.45), and with no premium or security_logs gate (parity §1.45, §19), so there is no feature_unavailable or forbidden failure.
reasons.null-period: audit_logs_period is never null in Tanvo (default 30 days, organization.DefaultAuditLogsRetentionDays), so every list applies a retention.
reasons.array-wrap: Ruby's Array.wrap of a scalar filter: Tanvo's filters are typed lists.
reasons.no-final: Reading events_enriched without FINAL when the organization has no ClickHouse deduplication: Tanvo's ClickHouse store always reads the current copy of each event (FINAL, parity §1.42 and the event store row).
